title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875 million worth of AI
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that the FAA will soon launch Smart, which stands for Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes and Trajectories — an automated software program designed to help streamline air traffic operations.
